question: The length of the shadow on the ground of a tall tree of height 30 m is 10sqrt{3} m. What is the angle (in degrees) of elevation of the sun?
solution:
Concept used:

tanθ = Perpendicular/Base

Calculation:

Let AB be the height of the tree and BC be the length of the shadow.

Let the angle of elevation of the sun be θ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a4b1dd6e5448755068da2f0ed723936678ce62ff5ebc4f8b106d6f80695bd204.png] 

Now, tanθ = AB/BC

⇒ tanθ = 30/10√3 = &am
